meta.name: Twenty One Pilots: Festivals 2026 Series
meta.description: Twenty One Pilots: Festivals 2026 Series is a documentary web series following Twenty One Pilots throughout their 2026 festival run. The series captures Tyler Joseph and Josh Dun's live performances, backstage moments, and life on the road as they perform at major music festivals following the Breach era.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Twenty One Pilots travel across Europe for performances at OpenAir St. Gallen, La Prima Estate, and Rock Werchter, offering a behind-the-scenes look at life on the road alongside highlights from each festival performance.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Tyler Joseph and Josh Dun take the stage at Rock Werchter, with behind-the-scenes footage capturing rehearsals, backstage moments, and their performance at one of Europe's biggest music festivals.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Invited to headline NOS Alive and Mad Cool, Tyler Joseph and Josh Dun reflect on returning to Europe during the 2026 festival season. Speaking backstage with SIC Notícias, the duo discusses reconnecting with European fans and what the invitation to headline both festivals means to them.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: In this episode the crew tries to figure out how to get Tyler onto a Ferris wheel in the middle of a song.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Tyler's wife doesn't answer his phone call, Josh reflects on the last few shows of leg one in Europe, Coors Light section, etc.
